steps.title: DTI Registration
steps.address: 3rd Floor, WDC Bldg, Osmeña Blvd, Cebu City
steps.notes: For sole proprietors. Apply online at bnrs.dti.gov.ph or walk-in.

steps.title: SEC Registration
steps.address: 7th Floor, Keppel Center, Samar Loop, Cebu Business Park

steps.title: Barangay Clearance
steps.notes: Required for all businesses. Must be from the barangay where your business operates.

steps.title: Sanitary / Health Permit
steps.address: City Health Complex, M.J. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City
steps.notes: Required for all businesses. Food businesses need additional sanitary compliance.

steps.title: Employee Health Cards
steps.address: City Health Complex, M.J. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City
steps.notes: Required for food handling establishments — restaurants, carinderias, bakeries, etc.

steps.title: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate
steps.office: Bureau of Fire Protection – Cebu City
steps.address: BFP Cebu City Station, N. Bacalso Ave
steps.notes: BFP inspects the premises. May take longer if corrections are needed.

steps.title: Zoning Clearance
steps.address: City Hall, Osmeña Blvd, Cebu City
steps.notes: Confirms your business location complies with the city's zoning ordinance.

steps.title: STD Orientation Certificate
steps.office: Cebu City Health Department – Social Hygiene Clinic
steps.address: City Health Complex, M.J. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City
steps.notes: Required for bars, KTV, and nightlife establishments.

steps.title: BPLO Application
steps.address: City Hall Annex, Osmeña Blvd, Cebu City
steps.notes: Submit all collected clearances. Assessment will be computed based on your business type and capitalization.

steps.title: Treasury Assessment & Payment
steps.address: City Hall, Osmeña Blvd, Cebu City
steps.notes: Pay the assessed fees at the City Treasurer's Office window.

steps.title: Permit Released
steps.address: City Hall Annex, Osmeña Blvd, Cebu City
steps.notes: Present your official receipt to claim your business permit. Congratulations!
